requirementSentences: Requires `graph:read` on the graph; `graph:write` on the graph, checked by the service (only when the parsed query writes); `history:read` on the history, when `has target.history`.

example.leyline#ListGraphs.name: ListGraphs
requirementSentences: Returns only the graphs the caller holds `graph:read` on in the organization.

clauses.documentation: Returns only the graphs the caller may read.
